articles.title: ZDI-26-566: BlackBerry QNX KEV File Parsing Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
articles.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of BlackBerry QNX. articles.title: GHSA: phpMyFAQ: SQL LIKE Wildcard Injection in Chat User Search Allows Authenticated User Enumeration
articles.summary:
### Summary

  An authenticated SQL LIKE wildcard injection vulnerability in phpMyFAQ’s chat user search allows any logged-in user to bypass the intended display-name search  filter and enumerate active users. The endpoint escapes SQL string syntax but does not escape `%` and `_`, which remain active `LIKE` wildcards.

  ### Details

  The vulnerable endpoint is:
```
  GET /api/chat/users?q=...
``

articles.title: GHSA: Winter: SQL Injection in Backend Filter Widget numberrange Scope via numbersFromAjax
articles.summary:
## Impact

The Backend Filter widget (`Backend\Widgets\Filter`) is vulnerable to SQL injection through the `numberrange` scope type when the scope is configured with a `conditions` key. An authenticated backend user with access to a list view containing a vulnerable filter scope can inject arbitrary SQL via the filter's AJAX handler, potentially gaining read access to the full database contents.
